name: Black Emperor
intro: The Black Emperor pathway bends rules, order and authority. Its users thrive by disrupting established structures and imposing their own distorted laws.

meter.name: Authority
meter.quirkText: Combat-only distortion, shields and rule abolition.

ability.name: Exploit Loophole
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Exploit Loophole — Deals 70% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Disorder damage (22% base DEF bypass); Lowers target DEF by 10% and raises your own DEF by 10% for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Barbaric Physique
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Barbaric Physique — +10% DEF; +12% Max HP. Passive.

ability.name: Bribe Weakening
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Bribe Weakening — Deals 100% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Disorder damage (22% base DEF bypass); Enemy ATK −20% for 2 turns; A successful bribe grants a small Authority gain. At 100 charge, redirect one enemy heal, shield or stat buff to yourself within 2 turns; offensive effects remain unchanged.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 25 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Distort Impact
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Distort Impact — Deals 135% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Disorder damage (22% base DEF bypass); Reduces incoming all damage by 40% until your next turn after shields; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 35 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Order Distortion
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Order Distortion — Deals 230% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); Forces the target's next damaging action to miss with 100% chance; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 20 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Magnify Disorder
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Magnify Disorder — Deals 180% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Disorder damage (22% base DEF bypass); Adds 1 turn to newly assigned target skill cooldowns for 1 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Chaos Field
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Chaos Field — Targets all enemies; Target skills have a 30% misfire chance for 2 turns; SP and cooldown are still spent; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 65 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Entropy Crush
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Entropy Crush — Deals 270% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Disorder damage (22% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Abolish Rules
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Abolish Rules — Deals 320% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) Physical damage (22% base DEF bypass); Removes current stat buffs, Guarded, Evade and shields; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Shadow Re-establishment
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Shadow Re-establishment — Targets all enemies; Deals 420% × (85% ATK + 55% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
